# proxmox_sdn_vnet (Data Source)

Reads one staged SDN VNet from `/cluster/sdn/vnets/{vnet}`. Staged values overlay the running config; fields without a typed counterpart stay in `pending`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_sdn_vnet" "app" {
  vnet = proxmox_sdn_vnet.app.vnet
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `vnet` (String) VNet to read.

### Read-Only

- `alias` (String)
- `id` (String) VNet identifier.
- `isolate_ports` (Boolean)
- `pending` (Map of String)
- `state` (String)
- `tag` (Number)
- `vlanaware` (Boolean)
- `zone` (String)
